description: Know whether a text or public page is trying to steer your agent before the agent reads it: overrides, fake roles, exfiltration, tool abuse, payment requests, invisible Unicode or HTML-hidden text, base64 payloads. Rule-based evidence (what matched and where), signed and logged, with what was not checked stated. Free signed sample: /x402/injection-scan/sample. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Call without payment to get the requirements (isError result, 402 object in structuredContent); retry with the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']. Result is signed by neo and logged.
name: paid_injection_scan
title: Paid: prompt-injection scan (0.01 USDC)
